name: Idol Investigations 'Kira'
source:
Mayumi Fujiwara has finally fulfilled her dream of becoming a professional photographer, working alongside the world's most adored idols. But when Mayumi senses something amiss with the agency's newest recruit, the beautiful and mysterious Kira, her content life is forever changed. Together she must join forces with the charming idol Akihiko in order to uncover the truth behind a decade old mystery.

[From [url=https://bcac.itch.io/idol-investigations-kira]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
藤原真由美终于实现了成为一名专业摄影师的梦想，与世界上最受崇拜的偶像一起工作。但当真由美察觉到该机构的新员工、美丽而神秘的基拉有些不对劲时，她的幸福生活彻底改变了。她必须与迷人的偶像明彦联手，揭开十年之久的谜团背后的真相。

[来自[url=https://bcac.itch.io/idol-investigations-kira]itch.io[/url]]
